title: Blitch vets Barber's four-man team on his boat

tellings.quote: I was looking for inconsistencies between those folks it's

plain: John Blitch, a former military scientist who says he was taken by an alien, told a podcast host, Jesse Michels, that around 2024 or 2025 he had a four-man team linked to a man named Jake Barber out on his boat. He says he was checking them, looking for places where their accounts did not match each other. If true, it would mean their stories held up under his own private questioning.
